_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV: 4 segments par taille (Commercial Risk > Health > Reinsurance > Wealth), puis Organic Growth (KPI guidance Aon).

kpis.signal: Plus gros segment Aon (50%), brokerage assurance entreprises (P&C, financial, cyber). Croissance regulière.
kpis.description_fr: Pilier Aon. Courtage P&C, lignes financières, cyber, énergie. Croissance organique 5-7%/an. 50% du CA total.
kpis.description_en: Aon flagship. P&C brokerage, financial lines, cyber, energy. 5-7% organic growth. 50% of total revenue.

kpis.signal: Segment differenciant. Aon = #2 mondial réassurance, marge élevée, croissance soutenue.
kpis.description_fr: Courtage en réassurance. Aon est #2 mondial. Marge segment ~30-35%. Croissance forte avec hardening cycle.
kpis.description_en: Reinsurance brokerage. Aon is #2 global. Segment margin ~30-35%. Strong growth from hardening cycle.

kpis.signal: Croissance accelerée 2024 (+37%) via acquisition NFP. Plus gros saut du portefeuille.
kpis.description_fr: Conseil et brokerage santé/benefits. Acquisition NFP 2024 a propulsé le segment. Croissance organique 6-8%.
kpis.description_en: Health and benefits consulting/brokerage. NFP acquisition 2024 boosted segment. 6-8% organic growth.

kpis.signal: Conseil retraite et investissement. Acceleration 2024 via NFP. Plus petit segment mais marges élevées.
kpis.description_fr: Conseil retraite, administration pension, conseil en investissement. NFP a boosté 2024 (+31%).
kpis.description_en: Retirement consulting, pension administration, investment advisory. NFP boost in 2024 (+31%).

kpis.signal: KPI structurel Aon. Cible long terme 5-7%. Mid-single digit 2020 covid, repris à 9% en 2021.
kpis.description_fr: Croissance organique consolidée. Pilote la guidance Aon. Cible mid-single digit. 2020 affecté par Covid.
kpis.description_en: Consolidated organic revenue growth. Drives Aon guidance. Mid-single digit target. 2020 hit by Covid.

_notes: Aon plc, segments revenue from 10-K Item 7 MD&A. FY20-FY24 values cross-checked between consecutive 10-Ks.
